answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using time-locked stake bonds mapped across a global atlas. Agents must lock capital into escrow vaults structured like compacted shale, signing periodic heartbeats with falcon signatures. This architecture forces an attacker to incur the verifiable opportunity cost of unbonded liquidity per concurrent identity. However, mandatory deposit thresholds erect a high economic barrier that marginalizes underfunded, independent agents.
